description: Per-element tables for the Materials Forge (braggsim.forge). elements[Z−1]: f0 = Rayleigh form factor on s = i · f0_step_A (Å⁻¹, linear interpolation, last value held beyond f0_s_max_A); idx = nodes of lambda_pm of mu_rho.json kept for the element, with sigma_cm2 (atomic cross-section, cm², log–log in λ), f_prime (linear in λ) and f_second (xraylib Fii, negative, log–log in |f″|) on them, end values held; edges_pm = absorption steps of sigma (K, L, M) with edge_sigma_cm2 = [σ on the short-λ side, σ on the long-λ side], a step for the interpolation of sigma
source: xraylib 4.2.1 FF_Rayl, CS_Total, Fi, Fii, AtomicWeight
